info.title: Black Infinity API
info.description: Development beta. All state mutations enforce same-origin requests. Passkey options use a short-lived HttpOnly challenge cookie. Payments, advertising and cash commissions are disabled. Role and detailed validation rules are enforced by the route handlers and Zod schemas.
